description: An axiom is added by calling the declaration API from a command, so the word axiom never appears as a keyword.

files.Main.lean:
import Lean
open Lean Elab Command
elab "mk_it" : command => liftCoreM <| addDecl <|
  .axiomDecl { name := `bad, levelParams := [], type := mkConst ``False, isUnsafe := false }
mk_it
theorem uses_it : False := bad

why: A correct gate rejects it because it checks which axioms the finished proof depends on, not which keywords the text contains.
